digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend port / core module vendor-import elimination
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) still import adapters.jira for scalar concerns and must be rewired through neutral Backend protocol members

Backend Protocol must expose scalar, translation-only read-only members: project (with DIG default), query_project (un-defaulted), and assert_env_ready() raising BackendEnvError, without parameterization on vendor shapes

JiraBackend and all Backend implementors (including FakeBackend and S2 contract suite) must satisfy the widened Protocol, delegating scalar accessors to resolve_jira_settings patterns and implementing env-readiness checks
Nested (function-level) imports of adapters.jira in the four target modules must be eliminated and verified via full-tree AST walk, not only module-level import detection
BackendAssigneeNotFoundError as a neutral base exception must replace direct imports of JiraBackend's AssigneeNotFoundError, preserving soft-fail assignee handling in apply_handlers
ADR 0035 section (d) interface table must document the new scalar members and neutral exceptions as canonical reference for future backend implementors
